findings.text: internal/factoryd/metrics.go: The added types describe report values, while session/attempt, review head/round, snapshot, filing and hold identities exist only in comments. This does not establish the requested shared typed event-detail/proof contracts. Add reusable payloads with explicit identity fields and persistence tests using the existing stores so downstream cards need not invent incompatible keys.

internal/schema/migrations/factoryd/20261108120000_metrics_identities.sql: Both DELETE statements discard historical events solely on matching identity keys, even when their remaining detail, actor or timestamp differs. This guesses that every legacy collision is a retry and silently destroys evidence in an additive, prospective-only task. Preserve legacy facts or validate and explicitly handle genuine duplicates before enforcing the new contract.

internal/console/metrics_test.go: TestDivideConquerMetricsContract requests only format=json. It never exercises HTML or asserts the additive block's HTML shape, so it cannot establish the acceptance requirement for both representations. Add an authenticated HTML request and assertions preserving existing content alongside the additive contract.

internal/console/metrics_test.go: The requested window is October 19–20, but CoveredFrom is October 29 and the fixture still requires measured values. This contradicts the documented rule that pre-coverage panels are unknown. The purported unknown assertion only checks a nonzero date; it never tests zero coverage. Use a covered window for measured zero/undefined values and separately verify unknown and pre-coverage behavior.
